persona: Listing agents and small brokerages who want video for every listing without booking a videographer
title: Turn listing photos into a property walkthrough video with AI
intentLabels: real estate reel from listing photos
workflowSummary: Choose the strongest photos and put them in the order a buyer would walk through the home, clean them up in one batch, then have an AI video tool add camera movement, transitions and music. Review every clip against the real rooms, and export a horizontal version for the listing page plus a vertical cut for Reels and TikTok.
samplePrompt: Turn these 12 listing photos into a 45-second walkthrough video with slow, steady camera movement and light background music.
beginnerNote: no filming or editing experience needed — upload photos and choose settings
pricingNote: Development demo record — see each vendor's site for current pricing
sourceType: Editorial guide, drawing on vendor product pages
accessNotes: Development-only demo of the editorial layer. Tool capabilities are described from the vendors' own product pages; pricing is deliberately not stated.
